ai_summary: Allcargo Global Limited reported strong unaudited Q1 FY27 results, its first quarter as an independently listed entity post-demerger, with revenue surging 20.8% sequentially to ₹3,522 crore and EBITDA significantly increasing by 94.1% to ₹33 crore. This robust growth, driven by volume increases and operational efficiencies in its international logistics business, indicates a positive strategic start despite a complex global trade environment. No immediate red flags are apparent in this summary.
